epsilon_preparation_future_only.engine: CPU torch 2.2.2 / float32 / local torch.Generator; same environment as bound original CE runtime; abort on version mismatch, keep global RNG unchanged.
epsilon_preparation_future_only.call_order: For each label, initialize local Generator seed422/423; consume exactly998 torch.randn((16,2,16,48),generator=local,dtype=float32,device=cpu) calls: one initial x plus997 reverse noises for t998..2; t1 zero draws. Then one torch.randn((16,16,48),generator=local,dtype=float32,device=cpu) is epsilon. No DDPM calls.
save_before_decoder: epsilon FREE/AMD arrays and file/tensor SHA
cumulative digest of all998 consumed Gaussian tensors, shapes/order/version metadata
bitwise mu_generated + epsilon*exp(log_sigma_generated) equality with every saved z coordinate
epsilon_preparation_future_only.failure: If any bitwise saved-z check fails, stop before all decoder calls; no alternate seeds or guessed draw alignment.
epsilon_preparation_future_only.interpretation: A later RNG-only reconstruction of an existing terminal generation stream, not an extra independent repeat; reuse across branches is paired common random numbers. Standard independent Normal interpretation is that of the frozen generator distribution, not statistical proof from one realised tape.

posterior_selector_future_only.order: Ascending existing train row_ids within matching labels (FREE126,AMD153), choose with replacement independently from reconstructed epsilon; both seeds proposed once here, not selected by outputs

posterior_selector_future_only.selection_material: Saved train-posterior row_ids/labels only; no sequences, dev, test, reconstruction scores or quality criteria

branches.z: epsilon exactly, no rescaling, terminal feature or inverse flow
branches.interpretation: Independent standard-normal input in decoder z space. It is not the native learned flow prior. FREE/AMD are fixed grouping/seed labels only; A is not terminal conditioned.
Conditional-on-training-cohort empirical posterior / memorization reference. Not a novel-generation result, not independent standard normal, not prospective activity evidence.

prior_coordinate_boundary: The model prior density is evaluated in zp=prior_flow(z,g). Decoder(z=epsilon) bypasses that flow. A native prior route would need a justified inverse and generation-available g; do not use true residue features, synthetic zero-g or guessed g to fabricate such a route.
outputs_if_separately_authorized: Every paired slot, group, selector index, latent inputs, epsilon, decoder raw output, original J tokens/sequence, status and failure traceback
All input/weight/state hashes before/after, original 64-slot denominator, actual setup/RNG/forward/export costs separately
Reuse existing fixed evaluator only for explicitly descriptive decoder readability/distribution/copy reference; never overwrite original E/L/G or treat B as successful novel generation
failure_policy: Retain every planned slot and error; no clipping, retry, resampling, seed changes, output selection or replacement. Stop pre-decoder on source/hash/epsilon/index mismatch. Nonfinite branch output remains a failure at its fixed slot.
